entities.name: Toluz, the Clever Conductor
entities.description: Human rogue of the Obscura on Capenna with a cane, mother of Parnesse.

entities.name: Parnesse
entities.description: Daughter of Toluz, whose union with Errant was to build alliances.

entities.name: Errant
entities.description: Intended partner of Parnasse in an alliance-building union.

entities.name: Obscura
entities.description: Capennan crime family to which Toluz belongs.

entities.name: Maestros
entities.description: Capennan crime family allied by the planned union.

entities.name: Invasion of Capenna
entities.description: Invasion that ended the planned alliance.

entities.name: Shadow Generator
entities.description: Item Toluz keeps to conceal herself.

events.summary: Toluz was injured in the leg while procuring a Shadow Generator and now uses a cane.
events.quote: While procuring the item, her leg was injured, and she now uses a cane.

events.summary: The Invasion of Capenna put a stop to the union of Parnasse and Errant.
events.quote: though the Invasion of Capenna put a stop to that.
